en.intro: Browse, install, and update plugins from the catalog.
en.nameTakenDetail:
A different plugin of this name is installed ({holder}).
Two plugins of one name declare the same loader entry id and cannot both load; installing this one would replace it.
en.notRestartedLogNotice: What this restart did is logged in {log}.
en.notRestartedNotice: dsh did not restart: after the reload, the process that was asked to restart is still the one answering, so the change has not taken effect. Restart it by hand: quit the running dsh, then run dsh web.
en.notRestartedPidNotice: dsh did not restart: after the reload, the process that was asked to restart (pid {pid}) is still the one answering, so the change has not taken effect. Restart it by hand: run kill {pid} (kill -9 {pid} if it does not exit), then run dsh web.
en.refreshFailed: Reload failed; still showing the last catalog
en.reloadNote: The server is already in the new state; this page is still showing what came before. Reloading discards anything in flight on this page.
en.restartBlockedDesktopNotice: This profile is managed by the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, so the shop cannot restart it. Restart the app to apply the change.
en.restartBlockedFromDefaultProfileNotice: This dsh was launched with --from-default-profile. From dsh 0.2.1 a restart would recreate the profile from its template and delete every plugin installed in it, this shop included. Restart dsh manually without that flag to apply the change.
en.restartBlockedPortZeroNotice: This dsh was launched with --port 0, so a restart would bind a different port and this page could not follow it. Restart dsh manually to apply the change.
en.restartBlockedSystemdNotice: This dsh process runs as a systemd service, so the shop cannot restart it safely. Restart the service manually, or set allowRestart: true in the shop row config.
en.restartBlockedWindowsNotice: The shop cannot restart dsh on Windows yet. Quit dsh and start it again to apply the change.
en.restartBody: Restarting disconnects this page and interrupts any conversation or task in progress; the browser will jump to the restarted address automatically, so give it a few seconds.
en.restartFailedLogNotice: The server did not come back after the restart, or did not stay up. The new process logs to {log}; you can also start it manually: dsh web
en.restartFailedNotice: The server did not come back after the restart. Start it manually: dsh web (see restart.log in the shop cache directory)
en.restarting: Restarting; the page will refresh once the server is back…
en.restartTransportFailed: The restart request could not be delivered. Please retry.
en.shadowedDetail: This package is installed but the current catalog does not list it (it may be shadowed by a same-named npm package, removed by the author, or never listed); it runs as before.
en.showIncompatibleTitle: Put plugins marked incompatible back on the shelf
